name: Noaiseo AI Article Generator — SEO, Styling & Images
author: parsasabrkon

sections.description:
Noaiseo AI Article Generator automatically generates, downloads, and publishes fully SEO-optimized articles — complete with images, brand styling, meta tags, and JSON-LD structured data.

It’s a complete hands-free content automation system designed for SEO professionals, agencies, and bloggers who want consistent, optimized content without writing a single line.

✨ Highlights
– 🚀 Automatic AI-based article generation
– 🧠 Full SEO integration (Yoast & Rank Math)
– 🖼️ Automatic featured images and inline visuals
– 🎨 Custom brand colors & typography per site
– 🕒 Auto-scheduling via internal WP-Cron system
– 📊 Dashboard with live analytics and charts
– 🌐 Lightweight, self-hosted, and privacy-safe
– 🔒 Secure REST API and validated output escaping

External Services

This plugin connects to the official Noaiseo API to generate, download, and publish SEO-optimized articles and images.

Service used:
Privacy & Terms: https://noaiseo.com/legal

Data sent:
– Website name and topic
– Primary and background color
– API key (entered by the user)

Purpose:
This data is used solely to create and deliver custom SEO-optimized articles for the registered website.
No personal data, analytics, or user behavior are tracked or stored.

Privacy Policy: https://noaiseo.com/privacy

Credits

Developed and maintained by Noaiseo

sections.installation:
1. Upload the noaiseo-ai-article-generator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly from your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to No-AI → Settings under the admin sidebar.
  4. Enter your API key (you can register at https://noaiseo.com).
  5. Save your settings — the first article will be automatically generated and published within a few minutes.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes. You must register at https://noaiseo.com to obtain an API key for your website. Each API key is tied to a single domain.

Does it work with Yoast or Rank Math?

Yes. Version 3.0.0 now fully supports both Yoast SEO and Rank Math SEO — automatically filling in focus keyphrase, SEO title, meta description, and keywords.

Will it publish automatically?

Yes. After saving your settings, the plugin automatically schedules article generation and publishing every two days.

Can I customize article colors or style?

Absolutely. You can define brand and background colors in the settings page, and every generated article will automatically use your chosen colors and typography.

Is the plugin dependent on any third-party JavaScript or CDN?

No. It’s fully self-contained, uses no remote JS/CDN files, and follows all official WordPress.org coding and security standards.
